ownership.graph_planning: control/kernel.goose owns traversal,task policy,checked sizing/max/alignment and tiled eligibility/size arithmetic
ownership.dispatch: control/kernel.goose routes all101entries,96leaf callbacks;oracle derives from unchanged native switch,not Goose implementation
ownership.executor: executor/kernel.goose owns graph loop,fusion choice,abort publication and per-node barriers
ownership.jobs: control/kernel.goose owns existing/disposable pool/reset/team selection,status and allocation failure;both OMP and pthread paths
ownership.pool: pool/kernel.goose owns allocation/free order,failure/partial-worker cleanup,masks,pause/resume,readiness/poll/wait/worker loop,kickoff/chunk/barrier state and NUMA/priority decisions

explicit_boundaries.boundary: Numerical compute callbacks and kernel-specific scratch/provider callbacks
explicit_boundaries.classification: Data/compute provider interface,not original graph planner or job implementation
explicit_boundaries.note: No claim that all numerical/provider code is already Goose;in particular MoE-local sizing still queries ggml_tiled_wdata_size and extra buffer work_size callbacks. Generic graph planning no longer calls original tiled helper.

explicit_boundaries.boundary: C ABI records,parameter constructors,hardware/NUMA topology discovery and native system allocator adapters
explicit_boundaries.classification: Explicit temporary ABI/configuration/resource inputs;does not count as full native-free core
explicit_boundaries.note: Do not describe owned GGML adapters as unavoidable final dependencies;only eventual OS/libc/CUDA/OpenMP primitives may remain justified.
System library internals not part of scoped instrumentation;GooseMP is a future idea,not this task.

explicit_boundaries.classification: Explicit disable rollback;not invoked by default controller;removal belongs separate closure task

explicit_boundaries.note: Actual Linux OMP/pthread and mock NUMA/priority gates are not proof of all hardware/OS configurations.

limits: This audit proves the existing control requirement,not full CPU/backend/memory migration,not every kernel numerical contract,and not original-C++ speed parity. P1-09/P2-14 and remaining stage1requirements stay open.
